## Rules

- `External` means the workspace links and drafts but does not overwrite the source.
- `Control root` means Stage 05 may reconcile approved changes there.
- `Generated view` means a report or summary that never becomes authoritative.
- Do not mark ownership as confirmed without a source or PM direction.
